colors.role: decorative only (<1%): templates pill / sidebar glow

taste.name: The screenshots are the only colour
taste.trigger: When building a gallery whose content is other people's brightly coloured CTAs
taste.decision: Chose a near-black, accent-free chrome (#0E0F11 on 87.5% of the surface, #1A1A1C panels, #C9CBD1 text, no coloured button fill) over a branded accent on buttons, filters and links
taste.reason: Because a visitor is judging the colour of the exhibits; any colour in the frame competes with them and skews the comparison
evidence: Submit Your CTA and Load More are #161618 with a hairline, not a fill

taste.name: Hairlines carve the grid, not cards
taste.trigger: When laying out ~60 thumbnails of uneven height
taste.decision: Chose a 3-column masonry with 0px gap and 1px column/row rules over floating cards with gutters and shadows
taste.reason: Because a ruled sheet reads as one catalogue to scan; separate shadowed cards would each ask to be looked at as an object

taste.name: Every category is always one glance away
taste.trigger: When offering 9 CTA types to browse
taste.decision: Chose a fixed 270px sidebar with a 40px icon tile plus 18px label per type over a collapsed menu or a horizontal chip row
taste.reason: Because browsers switch type often; a permanent labelled list with a picture per item removes the open-menu step and lets the eye find a type by shape before reading
evidence: secondary filters are 2 dropdowns (14px), not chips

taste.name: A finite page with a door at the end
taste.trigger: When the collection is longer than one screen
taste.decision: Chose a single Load More button and a reachable footer at ~4,700px over infinite scroll
taste.reason: Because a page that ends gives a sense of having seen the set and keeps the About/Submit links reachable; infinite scroll removes both
evidence: Load More button: 12px text, #161618 fill, radius 10px
footer 12px, two lines, after the button
